skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the key concepts of agricultural business management, including organizational structures, business strategies, and financial management.
Develop and implement strategic plans for agricultural businesses.
Manage production processes and resource allocation in agricultural businesses.
Organize product distribution and marketing strategies for agricultural products.
Manage financial operations and accounting in agricultural businesses.
Enhance self-learning and research skills, as well as the ability to evaluate the quality of work.
Work effectively in teams and present findings.
